# @fiscozen/\* design-system inventory

Source of truth: [`fiscozen/design_system`](https://github.com/fiscozen/design_system) @ `4b673ac`.
Local read-only cache (refreshed at session start): `.cache/design_system/packages/<name>/`.

## How to use

When implementing a UI region, **match its visual primitive to a package below before writing custom HTML or Tailwind**.

**Discover the API.** Read the component source directly to learn props/slots/events:

    .cache/design_system/packages/<name>/src/

**Install on demand.** If you need a component that isn't in the target domain's `package.json`:

    pnpm add -F @fz-design/<domain> @fiscozen/<name>@<version>

Use the version from this file. Re-run the script with `DS_INVENTORY_FORCE=1` to refresh out of band.
